```{r}


data("PimaIndiansDiabetes")
head(PimaIndiansDiabetes)
lda.pima <- lda(diabetes~. , data = PimaIndiansDiabetes)

```

The coefficients of linear discriminats shows $\beta_g = \sum ^{-1} \mu_g $
The group means is $\mu_g = \frac{1}{n_g} \sum _{i<n} I(y_i = g) x_i $

```{r}
y <- PimaIndiansDiabetes$diabetes
predict(lda.pima, PimaIndiansDiabetes[,-9])

```
```{r}
View(PimaIndiansDiabetes)
y.hat.lda <- predict(lda.pima, PimaIndiansDiabetes[,-9]$diabetes)
table(y,y.hat.lda)
```

```{r}
qda.pima <- qda(diabetes~. , data = PimaIndiansDiabetes)
y.hat.qda <- predict(qda.pima, PimaIndiansDiabetes[,-9]$class)
table(y, y.hat.qda)
```


```{r}

library(kernlab)
qda.spam <-qda(type~. , data= spam)
lda.spam <lda(type~., data = spam)
naive.spam <- e1071::naiveBayes(type~., data= spam)

y.spam<-spam$type
y.spam.hat.lda <- predict(lda.spam, spam[,-58])$class 
y.spam.hat.qda <- predict(qda.spam, spam[,-58])$class 
y.spam.hat.naive <- predict(naive.spam, spam[,-58]), type = "class") 



```
